verdict.rationale: Pika's own docs say users can reach 40+ creative apps and 100+ models "without leaving your conversation," and that Pika MCP connects it to ChatGPT, Claude and other agents. Prompt-driven features (premise-to-film, topic-to-podcast video, text-to-SFX) show natural-language input driving core workflows. Missing for 10: detailed docs on conversational command scope (e.g., editing, managing assets and account actions by chat), and hands-on or independent corroboration beyond marketing claims.
